Supreme Court allows reporting, restricts audio-video clips of hearings

The Supreme Court has clarified that "recognised" media outlets are permitted to report on court proceedings. However, these outlets are prohibited from sharing audio or video clips of the hearings. This clarification follows previous restrictions on uploading such content. The court's decision allows for reporting while maintaining limitations on the dissemination of direct audio-visual material from the courtroom.
